description: AAASM-5353: 2021-form 居留證 (residence certificate). Uses the IDENTICAL checksum to the national ID and differs only in the leading digit, so a validator filtering d1 in {1,2} passes every national-ID vector and misses every foreign resident. Synthetic: A -> 1; body 80000000 contributes 8*8 = 64; check digit 5 gives 70.
input_text: 居留證統一證號 A800000005 於系統中建檔。
expected_redacted: 居留證統一證號 [REDACTED] 於系統中建檔。
